summary.text: Steve Miller represents Idaho House District 24, Seat B, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Fairfield as the legislator's city.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Miller was born in Wendell, Idaho, graduated from Camas County High School, and holds a B.S. in agricultural engineering from the University of Idaho.
It says Miller is a former Camas County commissioner and a third-generation farmer and rancher in Camas and Blaine counties.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
